traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Paeoniaceae, Altingiaceae spiral, Peridiscaceae and Hamamelidaceae two-ranked. Opposite in many Crassulaceae (Crassula), whorled in Myriophyllum (Wikipedia (read 2026-10-16)). Weighting inferred.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): spiral in Paeoniaceae and Altingiaceae; two-ranked in Hamamelidaceae (states its own) and Peridiscaceae.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): compound leaves only in Paeoniaceae and a few Peridiscaceae; others simple, lobed in Altingiaceae. Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (read 2026-10-16): finely pinnately cut (still one blade).

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Altingiaceae palmately lobed; Wikipedia, Ribes (read 2026-10-16): leaves palmately lobed; Saxifragaceae already palmate usually.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): woody families leafy-stemmed; rosettes in Crassulaceae and Saxifragaceae, which state their own.

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, Haloragaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly perennial herbs, some annuals. APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Paeoniaceae perennial, woody families trees.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): racemes or spikes in Hamamelidaceae and Peridiscaceae, heads in Altingiaceae. Cymes 'usually' because Crassulaceae (about half the species) state cymes.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Paeoniaceae terminal; Peridiscaceae axillary. Terminal cymes of Crassulaceae and Saxifragaceae weighted 'usually' (inferred).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Wikipedia, Haloragaceae (read 2026-10-16): flowers radial. APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): no monosymmetric families described.

traits.zygomorphy.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): zygomorphy only in a few Saxifraga (unequal petals).

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): petals free; Saxifragaceae already rotate; star-like Sedum flowers. Inferred.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Altingiaceae semi-inferior; Wikipedia, Haloragaceae and Ribes (read 2026-10-16): inferior. 'usually' superior from Crassulaceae and Paeoniaceae weight.

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Hamamelidaceae 3-many, Altingiaceae 4-10, Paeoniaceae many. Saxifragales do not inherit the rosid value; typical 10 (two whorls) inferred from Crassulaceae and Saxifragaceae.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Hamamelidaceae and Altingiaceae 2, Peridiscaceae 3-4, Paeoniaceae 2-5(-15); Crassulaceae usually 5.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Saxifragales page (read 2026-10-16): Altingiaceae monoecious; Wikipedia, Haloragaceae (read 2026-10-16): most Myriophyllum monoecious, others bisexual; Wikipedia, Ribes (read 2026-10-16): flowers bisexual.
